action_trace_semantics.decision_times_s: episode time at the start of each decision
action_trace_semantics.policy_actions_raw: deterministic normalized policy action before the deployment gate; null for scripted controls
action_trace_semantics.applied_actions: action passed to waypoint_from_action after any deployment-gate fallback
action_trace_semantics.alignment: decision_times_s, policy_actions_raw when present, applied_actions, and waypoints_target_frame are index-aligned

compute_note: valid only if this ran serially in a single process; the MPC is charged every control step and the policy once per decision; post-solve runtime diagnostics are disabled
